risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's material identification stamp on the side of the tank.

risks.risk: The tank may have hidden structural damage, cracks, or corrosion not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the bottom and the interior of the tank.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring professional structural repair

risks.risk: The capacity may be significantly lower than 4000 liters.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's stamped capacity marking on the side of the tank.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a smaller capacity tank

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's material identification stamp (usually on the side or base).
Photo of the capacity marking stamped on the side of the tank.
Close-up photo of the bottom of the tank to check for structural integrity.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
